subject.title: Dashboard: shared vs private tabs + role/scope-gated visibility

question: Should private dashboard tabs be UI convenience inside one trusted operator domain, or a hard authorization boundary between operators?
rationale: The requested shared/private model crosses Control UI, operator scopes, persistent dashboard state, and privacy expectations; automation cannot choose the security promise maintainers want to support.

options.title: Keep As Roadmap Subissue
options.body: Keep this open until the dashboard base is settled, then implement visibility with explicit store enforcement, migration, and security proof.

options.title: Fold Into Roadmap Tracker
options.body: Close this only if maintainers want the Wave 2+ roadmap tracker to own all Tier 3 dashboard planning without separate subissues.

options.title: Defer Bundled Multi-User Semantics
options.body: Ask for this to live in an external plugin or later ClawHub package if maintainers do not want multi-operator dashboard privacy in core-distributed surfaces.

recommendation.title: Keep As Roadmap Subissue
recommendation.body: Keep this open until the dashboard base is settled, then implement visibility with explicit store enforcement, migration, and security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the recently merged plugin-tab seam and Logbook precedent that the dashboard stack builds on.
